_doc: Configuration of the conveyor plugin for the owner's sessions in this repo, which run the installed release (conveyor@conveyor, enabled in the gitignored .claude/settings.local.json). Nothing committed enables the plugin, so a clone without it simply ignores this file. Read it ONLY through conveyor-config (get <key> | source <key> | check); it is validated against the installed plugin's schema/conveyor.schema.json. Change the next-issue keys with /conveyor:config, or edit by hand. A key absent here is the reader's built-in default.

branches._doc: base == trunk is trunk mode: a ticket PR merges straight into main, /land closes the issue, and no promotion follows.

labels._doc: Label names the conveyor applies or excludes on; conveyor-doctor checks that every one exists. No landed label: in trunk mode /land closes the issue instead.

gates._doc: verify is THE gate list, in /pipeline's order. plugin_valid_ok and node_tests_ok are named by no /pipeline step, so each is run by its command and is green when that command exits 0; they are the two checks .github/workflows/ci.yml runs. Their names avoid tests_ok and build_ok, which /pipeline steps verify with npm scripts this repo does not have. review_ok is the judgement gate, the review verdict of /pipeline Step 2. prePush is what the plugin's pre-push hook (conveyor-git-hooks, installed by conveyor-setup --yes) runs after its secret scan, for a push that is not docs-only: both checks, the same commands CI runs, with no when — each reads the whole plugin, and node --test takes ~10s. review_ok has no command, so no prePush.

report._doc: otelLogs is the OTLP/JSON log conveyor-run-report recovers the subagent output a transcript never finalized from, so a run's total is exact instead of a lower bound (≥ $X). A leading ~/ reads as $HOME; the path holds no secret. With this key set, conveyor-doctor's SessionStart hook starts conveyor-otel-sink on this path. Recovery also needs Claude Code exporting to that sink: the five variables are in the plugin's docs/decisions/otel-usage-recovery.md, and a machine without them gets a doctor WARN and the lower bound.

pricing._doc: USD per 1,000,000 tokens, read from _source on _asOf; conveyor-run-report prints _asOf on every report. Move _asOf whenever a price changes; rows already in the ledger keep the prices they were priced at. A model missing here is named in the report and withholds the total: add it from the page, never guess. cacheRead is set only where the page gives a model its own cache-hit price (0.025x input on Fable 5.1, 0.05x on Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5); Haiku 5.5 uses cacheMultipliers.read. Haiku 5.5 is priced by prompt length: a request whose prompt (input + cache writes + cache reads) is over 100,000 tokens pays its longContext prices.
